Hi everyone — I’m Justin Hart, an independent researcher and a new mathlib contributor. I opened mathlib PR #37954, adding ENNReal.div_mul_div_cancel, and the contributor bot suggested that I introduce myself here.

The lemma came from a larger Lean formalization involving thermodynamic and information-theoretic bounds. Before sharing any broader results, I want to make sure I am following mathlib’s conventions and community norms. Could someone point me to the appropriate channel and advise whether the PR is scoped and structured appropriately? A review of the small lemma itself would be especially helpful. Thank you.
